# Halcyon Solar HX-405M — Product datasheet
Document HAL-DS-405M-C · Revision C · Issued 2026-05-06 · Previous revision B (2025-12-01)

Module type: 108 half-cut mono PERC. Nominal power 405 W (power tolerance 0/+5 W).

## Electrical data at STC (1000 W/m², cell temperature 25 °C, AM 1.5)
| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Maximum power Pmax | 405 W |
| Open-circuit voltage Voc | 37.20 V |
| MPP voltage Vmp | 31.10 V |
| Short-circuit current Isc | 13.80 A |
| MPP current Imp | 13.03 A |
| Module efficiency | 20.8 % |
| Maximum system voltage | 1500 V DC (IEC) |
| Maximum series fuse rating | 25 A |

## Temperature characteristics
| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Temperature coefficient of Pmax | -0.34 %/°C |
| Temperature coefficient of Voc | -0.26 %/°C |
| Temperature coefficient of Isc | +0.050 %/°C |
| Nominal operating cell temperature (NOCT) | 43 ± 2 °C |
| Operating temperature range | −40 °C to +85 °C |

## Electrical data at NOCT (800 W/m², ambient 20 °C, wind 1 m/s)
| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Maximum power | 305 W |
| Open-circuit voltage | 34.97 V |
| Short-circuit current | 11.14 A |

## Mechanical data
Dimensions 1722 × 1134 × 30 mm · Weight 21.5 kg · Front glass 3.2 mm tempered · Junction box IP68, 3 bypass diodes · Cable 4 mm², 1200 mm · Connector MC4-compatible.

Specifications are subject to change without notice. The current revision is published to registered installers through the installer portal and the datasheet library.
